excerpt.zh:
一个完全由不明骨头建造的原始城市废墟在经历这颗星球上的一场强力沙尘暴之后被发现。

我们的科学家渴望发掘这座可怕的古城。
excerpt.en:
The ruins of a primeval city built entirely out of bones of an unknown origin have been unearthed following a violent sandstorm on this planet.

Our archaeologists are eager to begin excavation on this grisly ancient city.

texts.zh:
部分久藏于[From.Planet.GetName]沙漠之下森然的白骨之城已经被[Root.GetName]团队仔细的发掘出来。

这个城市似乎是由数百万年之前原始外星社会在大陆上的沙漠中建造。在这片无水沙漠中缺乏建筑材料可能是这个失落城市使用骨头建造的原因……尽管我们还不清楚这些白骨来自什么生物。
texts.en:
Parts of the ghastly city of bones long-buried beneath the sands on [From.Planet.GetName] have been carefully excavated by the [Root.GetName] team.

The city appears to have been built by a primitive alien society millions of years ago, on a continental stretch of desert. The lack of other building materials in a waterless desert likely contributed to this long-lost society's use of bones in construction... though what manner of creature the bones came from remains unknown.

texts.zh:
一场针对性的挖掘既没有发现任何一具这个用来建造这座城市的生物完整的骨骼，也没有在城外发现任何相似化石的案例。关于在[From.Planet.GetName]上失落文明到底是从哪里获得了建造这座令人毛骨悚然城市的骨头仍然是个问题。

我们的研究人员已经假定这些骨骼来自某种与其共生或是其牲畜的物种身上，因此只会保留在他们城市附近。对其进一步研究应该揭示更多信息。
texts.en:
A targeted excavation has revealed neither a complete skeleton belonging to the species from whose bones the timeworn city was built, nor any examples of similar fossils from beyond the city. The question of where the lost civilization on [From.Planet.GetName] obtained the bones they used to build their macabre city remains.

Our researchers have begun to hypothesize that the bones may have been taken from a symbiotic or livestock species, kept only in the city's proximity. Further study should reveal more.

texts.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]的沙漠上建成了一座白骨皑皑的城市，让人毛骨悚然，个中的缘由如今终于被我们的科学家揭晓。近来的研究发现，这些骨头都来自于此星球上一种早已灭绝的爬行生物——这种生物染上了一种很罕见的遗传病，会导致器官爆发式增殖及软组织骨化。

似乎[From.Planet.GetName]上的失落文明注意到了这种遗传病，并加以利用。他们选择性地培育那些患病的爬行生物，以便在这片他们称之为家的荒凉砂地上稳定地获取建筑材料。
texts.en:
Our scientists have at last unraveled the origins of the bones used to create the macabre city on the sandy dunes of [From.Planet.GetName]. Recent findings have proven the bones belong to a long-extinct species of reptile native to the planet -- a species which developed a rare genetic disease, causing explosive organ growth and soft-tissue ossification.

The lost civilization on [From.Planet.GetName] appears to have noted the spread of this disease and then exploited it, selectively breeding the affected reptiles in order to cultivate a steady supply of building materials on the sandy, desolate wastes they called home.

summary.text:
# 白骨之城 / City of Bones

- 分类 Category：先驱者与考古 Precursors · 来源 Sources：common/archaeological_site_types/02_ancient_relics_arc_sites.txt:1758；events/ancient_relics_arcsite_events_1.txt:2411 · DLC：《远古遗物》Ancient Relics · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

勘察天体时，隐藏事件 ancrel.9999（on_survey_planet）以 5/405 的机会生成一个随机考古遗址（AI帝国或5年内刚发现过遗址者机会×0.2），再按各遗址的权重抽取；本遗址要求拥有《远古遗物》，权重100，出现在沙漠、干旱、稀树草原或盖亚星球上。全银河最多一处。

When a body is surveyed, hidden ancrel.9999 (on_survey_planet) has a 5/405 chance to create a random dig site (×0.2 for AI empires or if a site was found in the last 5 years), then picks a site type by weight; this site needs Ancient Relics and has weight 100 on desert, arid, savannah or gaia planets. At most one per galaxy.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

沙暴后露出的由骨头筑成的远古城市；三个阶段追问骨头的来源，最后得知它们来自一种因疾病而骨化的爬行动物，被城邦居民有意饲养。

1. 白骨之城：沙漠中由骨头建造的远古城市
2. 白骨之城：没有找到完整骨架，推测是共生或家畜物种

A primeval city built of bones uncovered by a sandstorm; three stages ask where the bones came from, ending with a reptile whose disease caused ossification and was exploited by the city's builders.

1. City of Bones: a bone city in the desert
2. City of Bones: no complete skeleton found; perhaps a symbiotic or livestock species

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 白骨之城 / City of Bones：骨头来自一种罹患骨化疾病的灭绝爬行动物，被有意选育（社会学研究、中型文物；设置 city_of_bones_completed） / the bones came from an extinct reptile with an ossifying disease that was selectively bred (society research, medium artifact; sets city_of_bones_completed)
- 前两阶段各直接给予50稀有文物。 / The first two stages each give 50 minor artifacts directly.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 终章对演化猎手有额外的“敲开骨头喝骨髓”选项；开头描述按是否沙暴暴露有两种版本。 / The finale has an extra Evolutionary-Predator option (crack the bones and drink the marrow); the site description has two wordings depending on whether the planet is colonised.
- 掷骰失败时使用通用事件池 all_random_events（见“考古遗址：发掘意外”）。 / Failed rolls use the generic pool all_random_events (see "Archaeological Sites: excavation incidents").
